title: Virtual Compute: evt meter
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. Meters originate in the provider resource export. Primary meter quantities use primary usage unit; a meter is positive and a meter reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed. Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference. bill actual measured usage overage permits measured quantities above included primary quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write. Round measured quantities to quantity decimal precision using rounding convention, apply minimum billable primary quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole billable primary increment. Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental meter. A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter. Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

## Evidence — export evidence

For meter, meter reversal, supplemental meter, The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, external reference, service interval start, service interval end, quantity. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference.

## Account meaning

Net primary physical consumption from positive meter and negative meter reversal postings; quantities remain grouped by source service period for billing.
